description: 51 street and campus props, one version each, v1.0. Decorative only. Upright origin (0.5, 1.0). Floor decals prop-manhole and prop-street-grate use (0.5, 0.5). Campus fence prop-fence-intact / dmg-1 / dmg-2 is 128×96 and is a separate series from 96×96 fence-damage-none|mid|heavy. prop-dumpster and prop-dumpster-green are both kept.
